aamod.config.title: Anti Aliasing Mod Settings
aamod.config.taa: TAA Parameters (applied while TAA is running)
aamod.config.taa.sequence.tooltip: Subpixel world projection sequence; GUI and held items remain stable. Changing it clears history, which then reconverges. Default: Halton (2, 3). Entity and block-entity model parts and vanilla baked geometry use per-object motion vectors, including model animation. Translucent or unmatched geometry, including FRAPI/Sodium extended item and block meshes, rejects history; particles use color-change and depth rejection.
aamod.config.taa.samples.tooltip: Jitter period: 8, 16 or 32; supported by every sequence. Default: 16. Longer periods increase coverage and require more frames to reconverge. Changing this clears TAA history; it does not change world resolution or enable SSAA.
aamod.config.taa.sharpness.tooltip: Output sharpening strength (0–1), applied only while TAA runs. Default: 0 (off). Higher values restore more local contrast and can emphasize fine-detail shimmer. Changing this keeps TAA history. Held items and GUI are unaffected.
aamod.config.reset.tooltip: Restore %s to its default. Only this option changes; the button hides when the default is restored.
aamod.config.iris.policy.tooltip: Default: Automatic. Automatic pauses this mod's AA while an Iris shader pack is active; it does not enable the pack's AA. Apply after shaders only allows the selected FXAA / SMAA mode on supported sRGB / RGBA8 output and can duplicate smoothing. Shader pack options are never changed. SSAA and TAA pause with active shaders. Without active shaders, all implemented modes remain available.
aamod.compat.iris.backend_inactive: Iris: inactive on Vulkan; using the native rendering path
aamod.compat.iris.automatic: Iris: automatic policy pauses this mod's AA.
aamod.compat.iris.preparing: AA paused: preparing Iris shader pipeline.
aamod.compat.iris.overlay: Iris: FXAA / SMAA after shaders; SSAA / TAA unavailable
aamod.compat.iris.ssaa: SSAA paused: Iris shader resolution control is unsupported.
aamod.compat.iris.taa: TAA paused: Iris shaders do not expose coordinated jitter, world depth and motion inputs.
aamod.compat.iris.color: AA paused: unsupported Iris output color.
aamod.compat.iris.shadow: AA skipped: Iris shadow pass or non-main view.
aamod.compat.iris.changed: AA paused: Iris pipeline changed during this frame.
aamod.compat.iris.output: AA paused: Iris final color output is not available for this frame.
aamod.compat.iris.query_failed: AA paused: Iris API query failed; see log.
aamod.config.ssaa: SSAA Parameters (applied when SSAA is selected)
aamod.config.ssaa.scale.tooltip: Applies only while SSAA is running. Renders the world at 1.5×, 2×, 3× or 4× per axis before downsampling. Pixel and attachment memory costs grow with the square of the scale. Default: 2×. HUD stays at native resolution. Exceeding the device size limit pauses AA and preserves the selected scale.
aamod.config.smaa: SMAA 1x Parameters (applied when SMAA is selected)
aamod.config.smaa.quality.tooltip: Official SMAA 1x presets: Low, Medium, High and Ultra. Higher presets search farther and include more edges. Default: High.
aamod.config.fxaa: FXAA Parameters (applied when FXAA is selected)
aamod.config.fxaa.subpixel.tooltip: Strength of subpixel smoothing (0–1). Higher values smooth small details more, but can soften the image. Default: 0.7500.
aamod.config.fxaa.edge_threshold.tooltip: Contrast threshold relative to local brightness (0–1). Lower values process more edges and can increase cost. Default: 0.1660.
aamod.config.fxaa.minimum_threshold.tool: Absolute contrast threshold (0–1). Lower values include darker, lower-contrast edges. Default: 0.0833.
aamod.config.fxaa.search_steps.tooltip: Search samples per direction (1–5), including the first sample. More steps can improve long edges but require more texture samples. Default: 5.
options.antialiasing.tooltip: Select one AA mode; the default is OFF. Graphics presets select AA: Fast → FXAA, Fancy → SMAA, Fabulous → TAA. Manually changing AA switches the graphics preset to Custom. FXAA and SMAA 1x smooth final world color; SSAA increases world resolution before downsampling. TAA uses world depth and history reprojection with neighborhood constraints and color-change rejection before held items render. Held items and GUI stay outside TAA history. Parameters apply only while their mode runs.
options.antialiasing.tooltip.iris: Active Iris shaders pause this mod's AA by default. Compatibility settings can explicitly allow FXAA / SMAA after shaders. SSAA and TAA pause with active shaders.
options.antialiasing.status.not_implemen: Status: selected mode is not implemented
options.antialiasing.status.missing_inpu: Status: required rendering input is unavailable
options.antialiasing.status.failed: Status: rendering failed; see the log. Reload resources or change mode to retry.
